ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CustomerAccountBalance_DEP
AS
BEGIN


--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance AS 
(
	-- System Reserved Amount -- SYSTEM_RESERVED_AMT -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'System Reserved Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.SYSTEM_RESERVED_AMT AS BalanceAmount
		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	-- Unclear Balance Amount -- UN_CLR_BAL_AMT -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Unclear Balance Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.UN_CLR_BAL_AMT AS BalanceAmount

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS

	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	-- Clear Balance Amount -- CLR_BAL_AMT -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId

		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.CLR_BAL_AMT AS BalanceAmount

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId

	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Future Unclear Balance Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp

		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId

		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	-- Future Clear Balance Amount -- FUTURE_CLR_BAL_AMT -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Future Clear Balance Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.FUTURE_CLR_BAL_AMT AS BalanceAmount
		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	-- Future OC TOD Balance Amount -- FUTURE_OC_TOD_AMT --

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode

		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	-- Used Unclear Over DACC Limit Amount -- USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT -- 
	SELECT

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode

	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	-- Used Clean Single Transaction Limit -- USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM --

		,'Used Clean Single Transaction Limit' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp

		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	-- Used Single Transaction Limit -- USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Used Single Transaction Limit' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM AS BalanceAmount
		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Sweep In Minimum Balance' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId

	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Freeze Date Balance Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp

	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId

	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	-- FCNR Account Total Debit Amount -- FX_CUM_DR_AMT -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'FCNR Account Total Debit Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.FX_CUM_DR_AMT AS BalanceAmount

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId

		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	-- FCNR Account Total Credit Amount -- FX_CUM_CR_AMT -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'FCNR Account Total Credit Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.FX_CUM_CR_AMT AS BalanceAmount
		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	-- FCNR Account Purge Date Balance Amount -- FX_BAL_ON_PURGE_DATE -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'FCNR Account Purge Date Balance Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.FX_BAL_ON_PURGE_DATE AS BalanceAmount
		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

	UNION

	-- FCNR Account Transfer Clear Balance Amount -- FX_CLR_BAL_AMT -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'FCNR Account Transfer Clear Balance Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.FX_CLR_BAL_AMT AS BalanceAmount

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId

	-- Purge Date Balance -- BAL_ON_PURGE_DATE -- 
	SELECT
		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Purge Date Balance' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.BAL_ON_PURGE_DATE AS BalanceAmount
		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId

		,'Accrued Credit Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.ACRD_CR_AMT AS BalanceAmount

		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId

		BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Cumulative Credit Amount' AS BalanceTypeId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.CUM_CR_AMT AS BalanceAmount
		,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,BalanceTypeId
,Timestamp
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,BalanceTypeId
,Timestamp
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,BalanceTypeId = SRC.BalanceTypeId
	,Timestamp = SRC.Timestamp
	,BalanceAmount = SRC.BalanceAmount
	,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
(
	CustomerAccountId
	,BalanceTypeId
	,Timestamp
	,BalanceAmount
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	CustomerAccountId
	,BalanceTypeId
	,Timestamp
	,BalanceAmount
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA;


END
